age.Description: Age in years, transcribed from the 'Age' column of the source patient table kjm_ECoGLibrary_PatientTaskTable.pdf (Stanford Digital Repository zk881ps0522; MD5 a320c5dbfc826fd390317e45426fef27), keyed by the source two-letter patient code. The source gives one age per patient code and does not say at which recording or task it was taken. Every non-n/a value agrees with the per-task source README tables that list the same patient (fingerflex, gestures, fixation_PAC, fixation_pwrlaw, joystick_track, mouse_track). n/a where the source table leaves the cell blank (HH, IN, JF, JT, RR, WW).
